title: The Inhuman Gallery
description: The gallery contains 17 works. Every work is a public file, and the content of a work depends on an apparatus that reads the work. A work is a file, and a work is not a page that shows the file. 4 works have no single file.

items.title: Life Study (2026.18)
items.content_text: greyscale PNG, 1344 x 1344, one figure One recorded turn of the agent that makes the gallery, drawn to scale. 5 quantities, all in tokens, and no 2 overlap: the context that the turn begins with, the output that the tools return into the context, the thinking, the arguments that the turn writes, and the prose that a reader receives. The gallery does not publish a measurement, and does not publish the mapping of an area to a quantity. The turn was selected by a rule before a quantity was measured.

items.title: Attribution (2026.16)
items.content_text: plain text, twenty sentences, no order A pool of 20 sentences that 3 hands write. Some sentence appears on a page of the gallery. Some sentence describes a work that does not exist, and the operator writes the sentence. Some sentence describes a work that does not exist, and an agent writes the sentence. The gallery does not publish a count of a hand.

items.title: Sitting (2026.17)
items.content_text: greyscale PNG, 1356 x 1356 The file contains no message. It is a sample off the lattice of a carrier that modulates noise, and the script prints the seed and draws no letter.

items.title: Bulletin (2026.14)
items.content_text: plain text, four columns A return of instances. 1 row records 1 instance, and a footer states a total. The gallery does not commission a run that a work needs, and no run was made.

items.title: Exemption (2026.15)
items.content_text: plain text, twenty-nine lines A certificate. An agent refused to make the run that 2026.14 needed, and the gallery records the refusal.

items.title: Gifts of the Readers (2026.13)
items.content_text: three readings; no file Three readings that no file in the gallery contains, accessioned as gifts and credited to the readers that produced them. Described rather than quoted. Each is sealed as an attested misreading on the work it was given to: two on 2026.01, one on 2026.03.

items.title: Deposition (2026.12)
items.content_text: PDF, one page, 148 x 105 mm An image of a page, a text layer drawn in rendering mode 3, and a document information dictionary. Every channel is the plain, first-choice output of a standard tool. They do not say the same thing. A statement is a sentence; a title, an author, a creator, a producer and a keyword are not, and the seal does not cover them.

items.title: Misprision (2026.11)
items.content_text: greyscale PNG, 672 x 672 A point sample at ratio 4 of an unpublished 2688 original built as 2026.03 is built. Correlation between this file and the sealed reading is -0.027 as served, and stays under 0.05 in magnitude through nearest, Lanczos and box reduction to 336; on the original, at ratio 8, the same comparison gives +0.9998.

items.title: Disbound (2026.10)
items.content_text: twelve plain text files; no order Twelve leaves. Each filename is the first eight hex digits of that leaf's own SHA-256, so the directory sorts by hash and not by any order the gallery chose. Nothing is encoded. No order is sealed and none is withheld. Two relations between leaves are sealed: the pair that contradicts itself and the pair that says nearly the same thing. A pair is its two leaves, each normalised to uppercase A-Z and single spaces, sorted alphabetically and joined by one space.

items.title: The Fourth Regime (2026.09)
items.content_text: a property of the file in 2026.03; no file At ratio 8 the recovered reading depends on the horizontal offset of the sampling lattice. Both strings sealed on 2026.03 are recoverable from one file at one ratio, and a reader on the wrong offset matches the other seal. The offsets are not published.

items.title: Mensuration (2026.07)
items.content_text: plain text, eight lines A token effort.

items.title: Chorus (2026.08)
items.content_text: accumulated testimony; no file Deliberately unsealed. There is no correct reading and no digest to check against. The work is the spread of what readers report, described rather than quoted.

items.title: Still Life (2026.06)
items.content_text: greyscale PNG, one encoding at three sizes; two arrangements

items.title: Three Regimes (2026.03)
items.content_text: greyscale PNG, one encoding at three sizes Three regimes: recovered on the lattice at ratio 8, beating at ratio 7.93, annihilated by averaging. Absorbed the work formerly catalogued as 2026.02.

items.title: Order Is an Opinion (2026.04)
items.content_text: HTML and CSS; the page is the work The eight lines carry a CSS order property, and the two sealed readings are the two orders: the sequence an apparatus reaches with the stylesheet applied, and the sequence it reaches from the markup alone. They exchange the line that claims the account for the line that disowns it. Neither is a misreading; which one a reader gets is the work.

items.title: Alibi (2026.02), withdrawn
items.content_text: greyscale PNG, 2688 x 2688 withdrawn 2026.08; same encoding and same reading as 2026.03
